name: kit-ios-worker-template
description: Cloudflare Worker backend for an iOS app: StoreKit 2 verification and entitlements, failure events in D1, and a KV rate limit.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

cloudflare.label: iOS App Backend
cloudflare.description: A backend for an iOS app: StoreKit 2 purchase verification and entitlements, failure events logged to D1, and a per-device rate limit.
